invariants: A source file is never changed by a registry operation.
A document is not fully read unless its exact indexed version has a complete ReadingRun without unresolved coverage gaps.
A proposal never becomes part of the approved baseline merely because it was received or analyzed.
Statement kind, evidence origin and verification status are recorded independently.
Asset lifecycle status, operational status and dated condition are separate dimensions and are not substituted for one another.
Normative compliance and evidence of actual practice are separate findings.
An alternative is not suitable until its mandatory baseline requirements and total comparable cost have been checked.
A comparable is not used in a benchmark calculation until the owner has confirmed its relevance after the known differences were shown.
An address, coordinate, map zone or installed position is recorded only with a stated source and precision.
The absence of a registered hidden route or physical element is not evidence that it is absent and cannot by itself make drilling, cutting or other intrusive work safe.
Installed-asset history is append-only; the current state is derived from verified events and assessments rather than erasing prior states.

A concrete physical unit is registered as an Asset only after its acquisition, acceptance or other individual inventory registration is evidenced; before that the product or option remains an EquipmentOption, Alternative, Comparable or quote subject, and installation and commissioning are recorded as separate events.
A completed AssetEvent represents an occurred event, while future work remains a MaintenancePlan or WorkRequest.
A maintenance due date is calculated only from a sourced rule and a verified base event or meter reading; otherwise it remains unknown.
Age alone does not determine replacement; condition, failures, supportability, compatibility, consequences and lifecycle cost are evaluated separately.
A replacement candidate is not suitable until mounting, space, power, data, control, environmental, software, service and regulatory interfaces have been checked where applicable.
A change to an operating object is assessed against the target location, physical elements, hidden routes, connected systems and dependent assets before work is recommended.
Manufacturer lifetime, maintenance interval and end-of-support statements remain sourced claims and are not treated as observed condition.
A LifecycleCostAssessment states its horizon, usage scenario, currency, included components and unknown components; a missing amount is never treated as zero.
A PriceObservation is a dated observation for a stated seller, region, currency, tax, delivery and availability context and is not an evergreen current price.
A Quote identifies exactly one commercial counterparty: a Contractor or a Supplier.
LifecycleDecision is an analytical record: recommendation_ready and awaiting_owner_decision do not authorize work or purchase.
LifecycleDecision with status recommendation_ready or awaiting_owner_decision records its conclusion as statement_kind recommendation.
LifecycleDecision status owner_decided requires an explicit linked OwnerDecision, and status implemented additionally requires implementation evidence.
EquipmentOption status selected and WorkRequest status approved require an explicit linked OwnerDecision.
A Supplier or Contractor found in external sources remains a candidate until its identity, scope, conditions and comparability have been checked.
